fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-03-30 states that the complainant discovered that jewellery kept in a cupboard had been taken from a place near Amudham Nagar Main Street in Madurai, on 2025-03-30 at roughly 12:05. A further person, Udhay Shankar, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000241, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Udhay Anand, associated with the number 9000000125, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned photographs, physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the residents were away for a few hours.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, documents, associate, afternoon, suspect, main street, mobile number
